content: kintu Isa zaitun faharot giyegoi.
Taforor din binna sore Isa abar dórmogóror uṛanot giye, zeṛe hár manuš okkol hibar sairo ḍakottu aišše. Ar hiba boiyore hitarare šikka diye.
Toi alem okkole edde Foroši okkole ekzon zenat dora háiyede mayafuware ainne edde hibare maze tiya goraiyore
edde hodde, "Ustad, ei mayafuware zenar hamot dora háiye.
Torar ainot Musaye endilla mayafuwaindore fattor maribolla ãrare hokum diye; kintu õne ki ho?"
Hitara hibare forikka goribolla iyan hoiye, zene hitara hibare hosuri dibolla ekkan muda tuwai fa. Kintu Isaye nise niyuriyore õl diyore meṛit leka šuru goijje.
Hitara zehon fusar gorat roiye, hiba uzu oiyore hitarare hodde, "Tũwarar butore guna sarawaye hibare foila fattorguwa marok."
Toi hiba abar nise niyuriyore meṛit leka doijje.
Toi hitara iyan funiyore ekzon ekzon, murubbi okkol loti šuru gori, giyegoi, šude Isa roigiyegoi, edde mayafuwawa hibar sarme tiyai aššil.
Isaye abar uzu oiyore he mayafuwaware hodde, "Mayafuwa, hitara hoṛe? Honokiye ki tore šasti no de?"
Hibaye hodde, "Malik, hono kiye nai." Toi Isaye hodde, "Henoile ãi o tore šasti no diyum; za ehon loti ar guna no goris."
Isa, duniyair nur
Isaye abar mainšor loi hota hoiye, hibaye hodde,

content.text: "Ãi duniyair nur; hite ze ãr fisa lo, hite andarot no ãṛibo, kintu hite zibonor nur faibo."

content: Foroši okkole hibare hodde, "Tui tor goba dor, tor goba soyi no."
Isaye zuwabe hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Zodi o ãi ãr goba nize, ãr goba soiyi; kiyollahoile ãi honttu aišši, ar hoṛe zair, ãi zani, kintu tũwara no zano ãi hontu aišši, ar hoṛe zair.
Tũwara manušor ḍoilla bisar goro, kintu ãi honokiyor bisar no gori.
Ar zodi o ãi bisar gori, ãr bisar soiyi, kiyollahoile ãi ekela no, kintu ãi ãr Bafor fũwati asi, ze ãre defeṛaiye.
Ar tũwarar nizor ainot o iyan leka ase ze, duizon mainšor goba soiyi.
Ãi ãr goba dir; ar ze Bafe ãre defeṛaiye, hibaye o ãr goba der."

content: Hitara hibare hodde, "Tor Baf hoṛe?" Isaye zuwabe hodde,

content.text: "Tũwara na ãre zano otóba ãr Bafore zano, zodi tũwara ãre zanita, toile tũwara ãr Bafore o zanita."

content: Ei hota okkol hibaye dórmogóror uṛanot šikka dibar šomot dan bakšur ḍake hoiye. Ar hibare honokiye no dore, kiyollahoile hehon o hibar ṭaim nu aiye.
Tũi honnuwa?
Isaye hitarare abar hodde,

content.text: "Ãi zaiyumboi, ar tũwara ãre talaš goriba, kintu tũwara tũwarar gunat moriba. Ãi zeṛe zair tũwara heṛe ai no fariba."

content: Ihudi okkole hodde, "Hite ki nizor zan nize loibo, ar hetolla hor,

content.text: 'Ãi zeṛe zaiyum tũwara heṛe ai no fariba.'

content: Kintu Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Tũwara oilade nisottu, ãi oilamde uworottu. Tũwara ei duniyair kintu ãi ei duniyair no.
Ãi tũwarare hoilam ze tũwara tũwarar guna okkolot moriba; kiyollahoile tũwara zodi biššaš no goro ze ãi oi hiba, tũwara hameka tũwarar guna okkolot moriba."

content: Hitara hodde, "Tui honnuwa?" Hibaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Hiyan ãi tũwarare šuruttu loti howat asi.
"Tũwarar babute hoibar edde bisar goribar ãttu beši kissu ase; kintu ze ãre defeṛaiye, hiba soiyi, ar ãi hibar hãsottu ziyan fuinni hiyan ãi duniyaire hoir."

content: Hibaye ze hibar nizor Bafor babute hor hiyan hitara buzi no fare.
Toi Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Tũwara zẽtte Adomor Futore uwore tuliba, hẽtte buzi fariba ze ãi oi hiba, ar ãi nizor torfottu hono kissu no gori, bolke Bafe ãre zendilla šikka diye hin okkol hoi.
Ãre defeṛoya ãr fũwati ase, ãre eka eri no zagoi, kiyollahoile ãi hamiša hibar razir ham gori."

content: Hibaye ei hota zehon hoiye, bout kiye hibar uwore biššaš ainne.
Ibrahimor bongšo
Isaye, Ihudi okkol zara hibar uwore biššaš ainne, hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Tũwara zodi ãr hotar butore tako, toile soiyi tũwara ãr biššaši.
Toi tũwara soiyire zani fariba, ar he soiyiye tũwarare azadi dibo."

content: Hitara hibare hodde, "Ãra Ibrahimor bongšor manuš, ãra honodin honokiyor gulam no oi. Toile tũi kengori hoi faror ze, ãrare azadi diya oibo?"
Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Ãi tũwarare soiyi soiyi hoir, hite ze guna gore hite gunar gulam.
Ar ek gulam hamišalla górot no take, kintu Fut hamišalla hiyanot take.
Hetolla Fute zodi tũwarare azadi de, toile tũwara soiyi azad oiba.
Ãi zani, tũwara Ibrahimor bongšor manuš, kintu tũwara ãre marifelaibolla kušišot aso, kiyollahoile tũwarar dilot ãr hotalla hono zaga nai.
Ãi ãr Bafor hãse zin dekki he babute hoi, ar tũwara hin goro zin tũwara tũwarar bafottu fuinno."

content: Henot hitara zuwab diye, "Ãrar baf Ibrahim." Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Tũwara zodi Ibrahimor fuwain oita, toile tũwara Ibrahimor ham gorita.
Kintu Allar hãsottu ze soiyi ãi funiyore tũwarare hoi boli tũwara ãre marifelaibolla kušiš goror. Ibrahime to endilla ham no gore.
Tũwara tũwarar bafor ham goror."

content: Hitara hibare hodde, "Ãra zoura fuwain no; ãrar ek Baf ase: hiba oilde Allah."
Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Allah zodi soiyi tũwarar Baf oito, toile tũwara ãre ador gorita, kiyollahoile ãi Allattu tũwarar eṛe aišši. Ãi nizottu nu aiyi; kintu hibaye ãre defeṛaiye.
Tũwara ãr hota kiyolla no buzo? Haron oilde iyan ze tũwara ãr hota bordaš gori no faro.

Tũwara tũwarar ek baf šoitanor, ar tũwara tũwarar bafor issa furon gora oilde tũwarar issa. Hite šuruttu loti ekzon kuni, soiyit no take, kiyollahoile hitar butore soiyi nai; hite zẽtte misa hota ho, hite hin hitar nizottu ho, kiyollahoile hite ek misa hoiya edde misa hota hoiyar baf.
Kintu ãi soiyi hoi, ar hetolla tũwara ãre biššaš no goror.
Tũwarar butottu ãre hone gunar hosurbon sabut gori fariba? Ar ãi zodi soiyi hoir, toile tũwara ãre biššaš kiya no goror?
Hite ze Allar, hite Allar kalam fune. Ar tũwara no funor, kiyollahoile tũwara Allar no."

content: He Ihudi okkole hibare zuwabe hodde, "Ãra ki ṭik no hoir ne ze tui ekzon Sameriyo, ar tore bute faiye?"
Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Ãre bute no fa, kintu ãi ãr Bafore šorman gori, ar tũwara ãre ošormani goror.
Ãi ãr nizor tarif no tuwair, kintu ekzon ase ze tuwa, ar hiba oilde bisarhar.
Ãi tũwarare soiyi soiyi hoir, hite ze ãr kalam falon gore, hite honodin moron no dekibo."

content: Ihudi okkole zuwab diye, "Ehon, ãra zani farilam ze tore bute faiye; Ibrahim edde nobi okkol morigiyegoi; ar tui hor, hite ze ãr kalam falon gore hite honodin moron no dekibo.
Tui ki ãrar baf Ibrahim, ze morigiyegoi, hibattuwaro mohan? Ar nobi okkol o morigiyegoi. Tui nizore ki mone goros?"
Isaye zuwabe hodde,

content.text: "Ãi zodi nizor tarif nize gori, toile ãr tarif kissu no; ãr Bafe ãr tarif gorer, hiba zar babute tũwara ho, hiba ãrar Allah.
Zodi o tũwarattu hibar zana nai, ar ãi zodi hoi ze ãi hibare no zani, toile tũwarar ḍoilla ãi o misa hoya oiyum; kintu ãi hibare zani edde hibar kalam falon gori.
Tũwarar baf Ibrahime ãr din saibolla aša loi kuši goijjil; ar hibaye hiyan deikke edde kuši goijje."

content: Hitara hodde, "Tor umor ehono fõnzaš bosor no o, ar tui Ibrahimore deikkos!"
Isaye hitarare zuwab diye,

content.text: "Ãi tũwarare soiyi soiyi hoir, Ibrahim zormo oibar agottu loti, ãi oi!"

content: Henot hitara hibare mela maribolla fattor feṛai loiye, kintu Isa hitarattu lukaigiyegoi edde dórmogóror uṛanottu baire niyoli giyegoi.
